column1: # Book 3 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 3.69 se is the object of remosse: removed themselves.
# 3.85-86 the fronted object made "have ... betrayed" read as causative; prodiderunt moves up one line.
# 3.131 quasi pars = a kind of part; the hedge had been dropped.

column2: to have fled far from these and removed themselves far, far away,
for often before now men have betrayed country and dear parents,
seeking to shun the precincts of Acheron.
and of the spirit, to be a kind of part of man, give back the name
